correctness.rationale: Exact unique decomposition at all simultaneous return cuts proves the full return-set weights. The Marchenko–Pastur product produces all Catalan-square moments. Schur complementation of a positive multiplication operator gives a Stieltjes moment representation for the block counts except first index; first index log-convexity is the exact inequality 25−16=9>0. Log-convex gaps imply each elementary FKG square, hence the full lattice property and association for all n≥2, with arbitrary positive site weights. Strict two-site covariance follows separately from Catalan log-convexity. Standalone exhaustive checker passed 1340 assertions through semilength 8; these finite checks do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Provides a global finite-size dependence theorem for the full random contact-set distribution rather than an isolated moment or finite test. FKG permits nonnegative covariance of arbitrary increasing contact observables and survives arbitrary heterogeneous contact fugacities, a natural property for pinning and paired-noncrossing-matching models. A generic component-count limit alone is not sufficient.
